verdict.rationale: A downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask for a SaaS security platform like Snyk, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no machine-readable API spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.snyk.io returning 404. The llms.txt docs index, CLI and MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
